Key Findings

  • Initial access through an unpatched remote-support tool used by the IT vendor.
  • Practice management database reachable from every clinic workstation.
  • No network segmentation between clinics and the head office.
  • HIPAA breach notification obligations apply to the affected patients.

Data Obtained

  • Patient records and treatment histories
  • Dental imaging (X-ray, CBCT)
  • Insurance claims and billing data
  • Staff credentials, HR and payroll
  • Practice acquisition agreements
  • Accounting and tax records
